name: iiit-h-seed
description: Demo seed knowledge graph for IIIT-H post-incident analysis. Generic guidance only: no contacts, numbers, capacities, room numbers or real SOPs. Every node needs IIIT-H admin verification before production use.

properties.note: Broad, non-sensitive entities only; admin must verify.

properties.text: Smoke may spread to nearby rooms.
People nearby may be exposed to smoke or fumes.
The fire could spread to nearby areas.
The structure of the area may be damaged.
Nearby equipment may be damaged.
The room may need to be closed until it is cleared.
Affected workstations may be unavailable.
Data stored on the affected equipment could be lost.
Services that depend on the affected equipment may be interrupted.
Overheating may lead to equipment failure or fire.
People nearby could be exposed to an electrical hazard.
Water may reach electrical equipment.
People could slip on wet surfaces.
Gas could build up and become an ignition risk.
People nearby may be exposed to hazardous material.

People nearby could be hurt.
Available room capacity may be reduced.
Affected food or drink may not be safe to consume.
Evacuation routes could be blocked or reduced.
The person may need qualified medical attention.
People could trip or be hurt where visibility is poor.
The trapped person may need responders to reach them safely.
The problem may recur if the underlying cause is not addressed.

properties.title: Move away from the area
properties.canonicalText: Move away from the affected area and keep other people away from it.

properties.title: Report the fire or smoke
properties.canonicalText: Report the fire or smoke to campus security or fire safety staff and follow their instructions.

properties.title: Follow evacuation instructions
properties.canonicalText: Follow posted evacuation instructions and move to a safe place away from the building.

properties.title: Stay away from electrical equipment
properties.canonicalText: Stay away from the affected electrical equipment and do not touch it.

Report the gas smell
properties.canonicalText: Move away from the gas smell and report it immediately to fire safety or facilities staff.

properties.title: Avoid flames and switches
properties.canonicalText: Do not use open flames, switches or electrical devices near the gas smell.

properties.canonicalText: Report the spill to lab safety staff and wait for specialist responders.

properties.canonicalText: Stay away from the swollen battery, keep other people away and do not touch it.

properties.canonicalText: Stay away from the malfunctioning robot and keep other people away until authorized lab staff clear it.

properties.title: Report the robot malfunction
properties.canonicalText: Report the robot malfunction to lab safety staff.

properties.title: Contact medical responders
properties.canonicalText: Contact campus medical services or qualified emergency responders and follow their instructions.

properties.title: Wait for qualified responders
properties.canonicalText: Stay nearby and follow the instructions of qualified responders when they arrive.

properties.title: Leave assessment to responders
properties.canonicalText: Leave the assessment of the person to qualified responders.

properties.title: Stop play
properties.canonicalText: Stop play and keep other people away from the injured person.

properties.title: Report the blocked exit
properties.canonicalText: Do not use the blocked exit, use another safe exit and report the blockage to facilities or security.

properties.title: Stay away from broken glass
properties.canonicalText: Stay away from the broken glass and keep other people away from it.

properties.title: Stay clear of overhead damage
properties.canonicalText: Stay away from the area below the damaged ceiling or hanging object and keep other people away.

properties.title: Stop using damaged furniture
properties.canonicalText: Stop using the damaged furniture and keep other people from using it.

properties.title: Report the damage
properties.canonicalText: Report the damage to facilities staff.

properties.title: Report the door fault
properties.canonicalText: Report the door or lock fault to facilities staff and use another safe route if the door is blocked.

properties.canonicalText: Report the problem to mess management.

properties.title: Avoid the affected food
properties.canonicalText: Do not consume the affected food or drink and report it to mess management.

properties.title: Avoid the affected water
properties.canonicalText: Do not use the affected water source for drinking and report it to facilities staff.

properties.title: Move away from traffic
properties.canonicalText: Move away from moving traffic to a safe place and contact campus security or emergency responders.

nodes.name: Stay away from the fallen branch

properties.canonicalText: Stay away from the fallen branch and keep other people away from it.

properties.canonicalText: Report the poor lighting to facilities staff and use a well lit route.

properties.title: Report the theft
properties.canonicalText: Report the theft to campus security and do not confront anyone.

properties.title: Move away and report
properties.canonicalText: Move away from the altercation and report it to campus security.

properties.title: Report the trapped person
properties.canonicalText: Contact campus security or emergency responders about the trapped person and do not try to force doors or equipment.

nodes.name: Report the problem to IT operations

properties.canonicalText: Report the problem to IT operations so that infrastructure staff can respond.

nodes.name: Report the problem to IT operations

properties.title: Report the problem to IT operations
Keep damaged equipment unused
properties.canonicalText: Do not use the damaged equipment until authorized staff have cleared it.

properties.title: Avoid saving to affected storage
properties.canonicalText: Avoid saving new data to the affected storage until authorized IT staff confirm it is working.

properties.title: Keep the area closed
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized facilities staff to keep the affected room closed until it is cleared.

properties.title: Keep the affected room closed
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized hostel administration to keep the affected room closed until it is cleared.

properties.title: Isolate power to the area
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized electrical maintenance to isolate power to the affected area.

properties.title: Stop the water source
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized plumbing staff to stop the water source once the area is safe.

properties.title: Isolate the affected equipment
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized IT staff to isolate the affected equipment from power and the network.

properties.title: Fire safety inspection
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized fire safety staff to inspect the area and confirm it is safe.

properties.title: Electrical inspection
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized electrical maintenance to inspect the wiring and equipment before the area is used again.

properties.title: Clearance before reopening
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized facilities staff to confirm clearance before the room is reopened for use.

properties.title: Inspect the affected device
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized IT staff and electrical maintenance to inspect the affected device and its power supply before it is used again.

properties.title: Preserve logs and backups
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized IT staff to preserve logs and available backups before restoration.

properties.title: Preserve logs and backups
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized IT staff to preserve logs and available backups before restoration.

properties.title: Replacement workstation

properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized IT operations to identify which services depend on the affected equipment.

properties.title: Start the continuity plan
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized IT operations to start the service continuity plan for affected services.

properties.title: Inspect cooling equipment
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized facilities staff to inspect the cooling equipment.

properties.title: Verify cooling
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized IT operations to verify that cooling is working normally before normal service resumes.

properties.title: Verify service restoration
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized IT operations to verify that the affected services work normally after restoration.

properties.title: Verify data integrity
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized IT staff to verify the integrity of data and backups after restoration.

properties.title: Inspect the power supply
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized electrical maintenance to inspect the power supply to the affected area.

properties.title: Inspect the power backup unit
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized electrical maintenance to inspect the power backup unit before it is used again.

properties.title: Review temperature monitoring
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized IT operations to review temperature monitoring and alerts for the equipment room.

properties.title: Review redundancy
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized IT operations to review redundancy and monitoring for the affected service.

properties.title: Clear the blocked drain

properties.title: Restrict the wet area
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized facilities staff to place warning signs and limit use of the wet area until it is safe.

properties.title: Inspect adjoining areas
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized plumbing staff to inspect adjoining areas for moisture or damage.

properties.title: Confirm the repair
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized plumbing staff to confirm the repair before normal use resumes.

properties.title: Inspect the shared pipe path
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized plumbing staff to inspect the shared supply and drain path instead of only repeating fixture level repair.

properties.title: Plumbing and electrical clearance
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized plumbing and electrical staff to confirm the area is dry and safe before equipment is used again.

properties.title: Inspect the water source
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized facilities staff to inspect the water source and confirm it is safe before use resumes.

properties.title: Review water checks
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized facilities staff to review routine checks for drinking water sources.

properties.title: Inspect the gas supply
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized fire safety or facilities staff to inspect the gas supply and confirm it is safe.

properties.title: Review gas checks

properties.title: Restrict the food area
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized mess management to keep the affected area restricted until it is safe.

properties.title: Check the affected food

properties.title: Inspect refrigeration equipment
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized facilities staff to inspect the refrigeration equipment.

properties.title: Review food handling checks
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized mess management to review food handling and storage checks.

properties.title: Isolate the battery hazard

properties.title: Inspect the robotic equipment
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized lab safety staff to inspect the robotic equipment before it is used again.

properties.title: Clearance before reuse
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized lab safety staff to confirm clearance before the area is used again.

properties.title: Review storage and labelling

properties.title: Inspect similar exit routes

properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized facilities staff to remove the fallen branch.

properties.title: Inspect nearby trees
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized facilities staff to inspect nearby trees.

properties.title: Repair the lighting
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized facilities staff to repair the lighting.

properties.title: Help the trapped person
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized responders to help the trapped person safely.

properties.title: Inspect the equipment involved
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized facilities staff to inspect the door or equipment involved.

properties.title: Review workstation power supply
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized IT and electrical staff to review the power supply and equipment used for the affected workstations.

properties.title: Review power backup health
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized electrical maintenance to review the condition and service history of the power backup equipment.

properties.title: Review shared outage causes
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized IT operations and electrical maintenance to review whether the outages share a common cause.

properties.title: Review cooling capacity
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized facilities staff to review cooling capacity for the building.

properties.title: Review electrical load
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized electrical maintenance to review the electrical load on the affected circuit.

properties.title: Review fire safety checks
properties.canonicalText: Ask authorized fire safety staff to review fire safety checks for similar rooms.
